messages:
Nora (PM): Starting a focused thread to lock launch gates for tenant isolation + multi-region routing. I sketched a 3-phase plan in the draft doc: https://redwood.internal/roadmaps/isolation-onramp. Need quick alignment on blockers and prioritization.

Diego (Eng): Key tech risk = KV cache eviction correctness when tenants are shielded. Also need perf targets under committed load.

Yara (Infra): Networking + KMS automate are infra heavy. propose a capacity commit threshold (e.g., >=4 reserved GPUs or sustained 150k tokens/min) to qualify for dedicated lanes.

Len (SRE): Ops requirement: evacuation playbook + tabletop drill before GA for any isolated tenant. Canary + auto-rollback is mandatory.

Priya (Sales): Two enterprise prospects require VPC+KMS and regional residency. They escalate timeline if phase1 includes these. Small customers want a cheaper dev lane.

Nora (PM): Draft launch gates: 1) perf SLOs (p95 target under commit), 2) KMS + audit logs, 3) network onboarding templates, 4) Ops runbook + drill. Which are blockers?

Diego (Eng): Blockers: perf SLO and cache correctness.

Yara (Infra): Blockers: KMS handshake automation and network templates. Also need per-tenant billing SKU mapping.

Len (SRE): Blocker: runbook automation and alerting. We can defer full self-serve console until post-GA.

Priya (Sales): Prioritization rubric suggestion: Revenue/strategic 40%, Compliance 25%, Complexity 20%, Time-to-value 15%. This ranks VPC/KMS high.

Nora (PM): Phase plan: Phase 1 = Private single-region with KMS + tenant shielding; Phase 2 = cross-region replication + evacuation tooling; Phase 3 = self-serve reserved lanes and pricing. Timelines: P1 ~8w, P2 ~10w, P3 ~6w (rough).

Action items:
- Nora: update doc with gates & rubric (EOD Fri)
- Diego: prototype eviction-safe cache changes + perf tests (2w)
- Yara: draft VPC/KMS onboarding template + capacity thresholds (Wed)
